d:
Chennaee ke shrinivaspuram men tamilnadu arban haibitet devlapment bord ne sal 1970 men jo rejidenshiyal kompleks banaya tha, aaj uski imarten jarjar halat men hain. ye imarten lo inkam grup ke lie banaee gaee thin.
Sthiti ye hai ki in imarton ki chhat ya divar ka koee hissa kabhi bhi achanak gir jata hai. iske bavjud yahan rahne vale logon ke lie is jagah ko khali karna mushkil hai.
Vidiyo: vijyanand aur ranjit
BBC World Service ke nae aip ko daunlod karen.
BBC News hindi ko chunen aur paie nyuz alart, laiv tivi, podkast... sab ek jagah.
